variant.orientationHint: How the generator fits the zone layout into the map square: packing mode, layout rotation and the zero-angle zone.
variant.modeHint: mode — MinimalBoundingSquare: into the bounding square; BoundingCircle: into a circle
variant.angleMinHint: baseAngleMin — lower bound of the layout’s base rotation (0–360)
variant.angleMaxHint: baseAngleMax — upper bound of the layout’s base rotation (0–360)
variant.anglesNote: Equal min/max (e.g. 45/45) + randomAngleStep 90 fix the diagonal up to 90° rotations.
variant.amplitudeHint: randomAngleAmplitude — amplitude of the layout’s random extra rotation (0–360)
variant.stepHint: randomAngleStep — discretization step of the random angle (90 = rotations are multiples of 90°)
variant.zeroZoneHint: zeroAngleZone — reference zone of the zero angle (the direction the layout “faces”)
variant.borderHint: Outer map border: corner rounding, a ring of obstacles and a ring of water along the edge.
variant.cornerHint: cornerRadius — rounding of the play area corners (0–0.8)
variant.obstaclesWidthHint: obstaclesWidth — width of the obstacle ring along the edge, in tiles (2–6)
variant.waterWidthHint: waterWidth — width of the water ring (0 = no water along the edge)
variant.waterTypeHint: waterType — water type (sid); only “water grass” in stock templates
